description: Reusable MSTR → Power BI pattern catalogue. Extend per estate; keep IDs stable.

patterns.mstr: Crosstab / grid with attributes on rows/columns and metrics in cells
patterns.pbi: Matrix visual over star schema; measures evaluate in filter context
patterns.notes: Subtotals become matrix subtotals or DAX; do not recreate row-level grid arithmetic blindly

patterns.pbi: DAX DIVIDE with explicit numerator/denominator measures
Conditional formatting rules on matrix/table visual

patterns.mstr: Region subtotals + grand total in grid engine
patterns.pbi: Matrix row subtotals / visual calculations; verify aggregation grain
Multi-page Power BI report; page-level visuals
Synced slicers across pages (Sync slicers pane)
Hierarchy on dimension + drill-down on visual, or page navigation buttons
Card / KPI visuals + line chart; shared date axis
Date slicer (between) or relative date filter; optional bookmark default
patterns.notes: Slicers filter context; they do not reshape the generated SQL the way MSTR prompts can

patterns.mstr: Security filter tied to logged-in user attributes
patterns.pbi: RLS role with DAX predicate against security dimension / USERPRINCIPALNAME()
TOPN / RANKX measure or visual-level filter; must evaluate inside RLS context
patterns.daxTemplate: Top10 Sales := CALCULATE ( [Sales], KEEPFILTERS ( TOPN ( 10, ALLSELECTED ( DimProduct[Product] ), [Sales], DESC ) ) )

patterns.pbi: Prefer flattened star dims + fact; Direct Lake if Fabric lakehouse
One semantic model + thin reports / field parameters
